reason: Refuted as written. It is mostly a repeat of plan items, and its one new part rests on a wrong premise. (1) Duplicate: I-229 and I-258 are already in the plan. They check API SELECTED == pair by ref and re-check on 28 Sep evening and on 29 Sep at 12:00Z and 18:00Z (timers 012fa6dd, 328f7392, 18ff4796, CONTEXT l.2362-2366). The 19:00Z L9 read is also in the plan (IDEAS l.577, CONTEXT l.2762), and so is the re-read after every re-tick (R16-A1 (2)). The only new element is the ~20:05Z read. (2) Wrong premise: 20:00Z is our own buffer. Kaggle does not freeze the selection then. CONTEXT l.2038 says 'Ticks are reversible until the deadline' (29 Sep 23:59Z). So the name 'FINALS FROZEN' at 20:05Z is false: the user can still change SELECTED after that read. The branch 'on a mismatch the user fixes it by 20:00Z' also cannot work at 20:05Z; the real fix window is to 23:59Z. v2 (c)'s phrase 'SELECTED at 20:00Z' has the same flaw. What Kaggle scores is SELECTED at the deadline, so v2 (d)'s F should be read after 23:59Z. v2 (d)'s first competition_submissions read at 30 Sep 00:15Z already does that. (3) Scope creep: the 'poll.log header < 15 min and not a 429' check is W6, a pre-submit rule, and has nothing to do with a tick check. The poller also stops at 20:00Z, so at 20:05Z this check fails or means nothing. N954/N955/team count need a leaderboard download and are private-read inputs (R16-A9), not tick inputs; round 16 already rejected N954 thresholds. Checking 'not byte-identical' again each time adds nothing once it has been checked after a re-tick, because the files are immutable. (4) The value is overstated. If fewer than 2 files are ticked, Kaggle auto-selects from the best public scores (CONTEXT l.2035), so a defect degrades the pair; it does not lose the whole pair. Feasibility is trivial (1 API call, nothing submitted, no rule touched), but the expected value is ~0 beyond the existing checks.
fix: Do not add a 'FINALS FROZEN' step. At most add one line to the RESUME schedule: '29 Sep ~20:05Z (session alive, or the first action of a resumed session before 23:30Z): API SELECTED == expected pair by ref. On a mismatch, push at once; the user can still re-tick until 23:59Z (Kaggle), because the 20:00Z cutoff is our own buffer.' Correct v2 (c)/(d) so that F = API SELECTED read after 29 Sep 23:59Z, i.e. the planned 30 Sep 00:15Z competition_submissions read, and log 'FINALS FINAL [refs]' there. Keep the poll.log freshness check and N954/N955 out of the tick card.
realistic_gain: ~0 in expected score. It is hygiene: P(a SELECTED defect that the existing 12:00/18:00/19:00Z checks miss and the user can still fix) is well below 1%. The one useful point is the wording fix: a defect seen after 20:00Z is still fixable until 23:59Z.
